character.canonHint: Drawings follow the final design. Unlock it in Creator › Art style › Reference images.
character.canonEmptyHint: The front will follow this final design and appear here

decompose.hint: Have the AI find the pieces in the main illustration and turn them into canvas nodes

create.error: Couldn't add it to the canvas. Try again.

toolbar.label: Canvas tools
toolbar.chooseReference: Choose a reference image for the canvas
toolbar.tidyHint: Move the pieces back to either side of the character

part.cropAlt: Where {{name}} is in the main illustration

formalReference.label: Used when drawing
formalReference.fallback: Set as the current style reference

annotation.title: Title
annotation.titlePlaceholder: What to take from this image
annotation.saveError: The note wasn't saved. Your text is still here.
annotation.saveErrorHint: Not saved yet. Your draft is kept.
annotation.deleteErrorHint: The card is still on the canvas.

addPiece.title: Add a piece
addPiece.subtitle: Start with a name and what it looks like. You can draw its design on its own later.

inspector.proposed: Piece the AI found in the main illustration
inspector.cropNote: This area is cropped from the main illustration; it isn't a design yet. Draw a design to see the front, back and details clearly.
inspector.noDesign: No design yet. Describe it, then draw one.
inspector.needPortrait: Pieces are drawn to match the main illustration, so you need one first
inspector.needPortraitNote: Draw a main illustration in the Creator first. Then pieces can be drawn on their own to match it.
inspector.removeKeepHint: Pieces with images are kept and just taken off
inspector.removeHint: Remove this piece from the character

views.adjustHint: Framed wrong? Drag the boxes and crop again
views.driftHint: All three views should be the same height. A gap this big means the proportions may have drifted (redraw this view) or the crop is off (adjust the crop).

slot.offerHint: Find the front, side and back in this image and crop them, or use it as the front if it shows one figure
slot.detectingHint: AI is looking for the front, side and back views and will crop them automatically
slot.noneTitle: This image has only one angle
slot.noneHint: This image has one figure: use it as the front and add the side and back, or import a turnaround you already have
slot.failedHint: Try again, or frame the front, side and back by hand
slot.emptyHint: Draw the front first, then add the side and back here one at a time. If you already have a turnaround, import it
slot.emptyCanonHint: Draw the front from the final design, then add the side and back. If the final design already is a turnaround, use it directly
slot.asFront: Use as front, add side and back
slot.readingHint: AI is splitting out the gear and checking whether this is a front view or a turnaround. Then you can draw the other views

editor.title: Adjust turnaround crop
editor.subtitle: Drag a box to move it and its corners to resize. Applying crops new images; the original stays as is
editor.tip: Just cover the whole figure. It tightens to the figure automatically, and the three crops get the same size with the feet aligned.
editor.boxAria: {{view}} crop box: arrow keys move it, Shift + arrow keys resize it
editor.redrawnNote: {{views}} was redrawn; it stays as is unless you tick it.

views.redrawHint: Redraw the {{view}} view from the front: say what to fix first; adopting it replaces just this one
views.missingHint: Draw the {{view}} view from the front; it lines up automatically

dialog.drawSubtitle: Drawn from the front with the same design and height, then sized to match automatically.
dialog.redrawSubtitle: The AI only sees the front and the other confirmed views. The current {{view}} view is not sent, so the mistake isn't copied.
dialog.fixPlaceholder: e.g. The tail should come out of the middle of the lower back
dialog.notePlaceholder: e.g. The hair ornament is on the left ear and shows from the side
dialog.notesSent: These {{count}} notes go to the AI too
dialog.noNotes: For things the AI should always keep (like where the tail starts), add notes in the side-by-side view

views.missingFront: No front view. The other views are drawn from it, so frame the front with Adjust crop first

extraHint.frontQuarter: 45° turn: shows the front and left side
extraHint.backQuarter: 45° turn: shows the back and left side
extraHint.otherSide: Facing right, for things only on the right side

spec.front: Face and body toward the viewer.
spec.side: Facing left: shows the character's left side.
spec.back: Back to the viewer: the character's left hand is on the left, mirrored from the front.
spec.frontQuarter: Turned 45° toward the left: shows the front and the character's left side.
spec.backQuarter: Back to the viewer, turned 45° to the left: shows the back and the character's left side.
spec.otherSide: Facing right: shows the character's right side, so things only on the right are drawn clearly.

viewer.title: {{name}} · Turnaround
viewer.subtitle: Every view at the same height with the feet lined up. Click "Add note", then click a spot on an image to say what to watch for
viewer.headLine: Head
viewer.guideHint: Drag to move, double-click to remove
viewer.notesHint: These notes go to the AI whenever any view is drawn. Click a number to edit it, drag it to move it.
viewer.empty: No notes yet. For example, mark the tail root on the back: "Tail: grows from the middle of the lower back, white tip".
viewer.noteTextPlaceholder: e.g. Grows from the middle of the lower back, white tip, usually curled up
viewer.noteSent: From now on, every image of this character sends this spot and note to the AI.
viewer.placeOn: Add a note in the middle of {{view}} (move it with the arrow keys afterwards)
